scope: One (p,t) CMVM instance, all96 input channels. Independent H8 graphs run serially with one common 96x12 input cache; scratch maximum, not sum. No pipeline timing, EDA, GPU, new graph compilation or PPA.
scheduler: Three fixed legal graph orders; two bypass registers, lazy RF writeback, immutable input cache. Final outputs stream through one result register and backpressure stalls compute. No optimality claim or whole96-output/Y storage requirement.

full.expanded_bit_sum_scope: Sum of node result widths, not adder area, RF size, placed routing or pipeline registers.
